name: The Wicked God Descends!
main_effect:
[Main] You may play 1 [Composite] trait card from your trash with the play cost reduced by 4. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When any of your Digimon with [Millenniummon] in its name would leave the battle area, ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・ You may play 1 [Wicked God] trait Digimon card with a play cost 1 higher than that Digimon from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Place this card in the battle area.
